summary: Blast radius: 11 conformance outputs were re-blessed (messages and hints; code and field unchanged, CHANGELOG lists them). One loses information: canon init --policy light --no-policy used to carry expected: light, standard, strict (clap's conflict context) and now says only that --check, --policy, --no-policy are exclusive; the values of --policy are no longer in the refusal. The brief treats help text as not a contract and the document is unchanged (all 105 identical), so this is a note: an agent that hit the conflict by mistake reads the legal values from canon schema init, not from the refusal. Also: no test reads a refusal's message text across commands, so a further message change would pass the suite.
